column1: Keep the broth warm in a saucepan over low heat.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large, deep pan over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms for about 3 minutes until softened, then move them and their juices to a bowl.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the pan and cook the shallots for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice and toast for about 2 minutes until coated and pale golden.
Pour in the wine and stir until it is fully absorbed.
Add the warm broth 1/2 cup at a time, stirring until each addition is absorbed, until the rice is tender but still firm to the bite, 15–20 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the mushrooms with their juices, the Parmesan, butter, and chives. Season with salt and pepper and serve right away.
